metric_definitions.confident_misrouting_count: Automatically routed cases that are wrong-category or must-review. Counts unsafe routes, not merely high probability.
metric_definitions.high_confidence_wrong_count: Probability >=0.8 while category wrong or request must-review; includes predictions that routing gates correctly reject.
metric_definitions.auto_accuracy: Correct single supported category / all automatically routed cases. Any automated vague/mixed/OOD case counts as incorrect.
metric_definitions.coverage_denominator: All 88 challenge requests, including required-review cases; maximum possible safe coverage is 48/88.
